metadata.title: CGAL 6.2.1 - Polygon Mesh Processing: Connected Components

query: site:doc.cgal.org Polygon Mesh Processing connected components edge_is_constrained_map
decision: Primary current documentation supports computing face components while treating selected edges as constrained. The custom dual cut is a useful topology discriminator; this source does not supply Sugata boundary placement, seam semantics, cap coverage, or visual qualification.
quote: Connected components are computed with respect to the constrained edges
implementation: No CGAL installation/library adoption. Custom exact topology arrays and one graph cut in pinned constructor.
